verdict.summary: The stale-run reaper is fail-closed and appropriately scoped. It requires both the merge_group event and a positively recognized queue ref, refuses incomplete or unreadable queue state, preserves current heads and grace-period runs, bounds cancellations, and re-reads both queue and run state before each mutation. The workflow uses default-branch policy code and job-level least privilege. The tests exercise the real mutation path with a stateful fake and cover active-current controls, empty/rebuilt queues, incomplete/null API responses, duplicate delivery, cancellation failures, dry-run behavior, and both queue/run TOCTOU changes. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test defect was found in the diff.
